summary.text: Martha Brown is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 19A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Keith Allen.
An educational consultant with more than 30 years of experience as an educator and researcher, she lives in Faribault.

paragraphs.text: Martha Brown graduated from McDowell High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rochester in 1988, and received a Ph.D. from Florida Atlantic University in 2015.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in a working-class family and has worked for more than 30 years as an educator, researcher, program evaluator, consultant, author and musician.

She said she lives in Faribault, where she teaches and volunteers, is a member of the Faribault Rotary Club, served on the City of Faribault Environmental Commission, and volunteers with the Community Action Center.
Brown listed universal health care as her first key message, saying she supports building a new universal health care system, and also named economic security for working and rural Minnesotans.
